propositions: Current CLI syntax is fragmented across multiple imperative parsers, hand-maintained help files, and descriptions, creating drift between runtime behavior and documentation.
A single-source parser factory system must be established using deterministic, side-effect-free argparse construction that serves both runtime execution and canonical help generation.
All command families (core, advanced, bridge, reconciler, workflow, audit, identity) must migrate from imperative parsing to shared parser factories with byte-deterministic help output.
Parser parity must be verified: no unapproved deltas in accepted/rejected argv, diagnostics, streams, or exit codes between the old and new implementations.
Top-level routing must recognize only global config tokens, command identity, and help forms, with nested parsing delegated to each handler's factory.
Generated help artifacts and grouped overview must be byte-current, immutable, and served before operation/config/store/handler boundaries; retired syntax must remain undiscoverable.
